result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major data/content bug showing 'NaN' delivery price, a layout issue with cut-off content at the screen edge, and a minor inconsistency in delivery fee formatting.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating a calculation or data-binding error.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee calculation logic to ensure a valid numeric value is always displayed, and add a fallback (e.g., 'Free' or hide field) if data is missing.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' card and its content are cut off at the right edge of the screen in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section.
issues.suggestion: This is expected behavior for a horizontal scroll list, but ensure there's a visual cue (like partial card peeking) to indicate scrollability, or add a subtle gradient fade at the edge.

issues.description: Delivery fee formatting is inconsistent - some show '€0.90 delivery', others show '€0 delivery' as a badge overlay, creating visual inconsistency in presentation style.
issues.suggestion: Standardize how delivery fees are displayed across all card types, either always as overlay badges or always as text below the title.
